title: Task: Backfill queued preservation for regular Reflections foil articles
body:
## Task
Complete deferred archive preservation from story381 without delaying the foil article publication Bill authorized on14 November2026.

Bill: “Please don't let Wayback block this. Queue the preservation requests for later and proceed with publishing the remaining217 foil articles and finishing the ten incomplete ones.”

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Reconcile evidence/381/preservation-queue.json and source ops/wayback/queue.txt against published exact public image versions, their SHA1/SHA256, original source photographs and inherited citations.
- [ ] After archive recovery, capture each outstanding public image original/version and compare raw replay bytes; add the checked replay to its File Preservation section using current revision guards.
- [ ] Preserve cited source resources/snapshots and repair citation-local archive links without changing card text or asserting unchecked captures verified.
- [ ] Record strict archival verification and updated remaining counts; merge source/evidence backups. Preserve existing valid captures, skip already completed items, and keep uncaptured staging until verified.

## Current state
Anonymous saves520; public POST explicitly throttles429; documented authenticated route401. No bypass requests or invented captures. Publication proceeds under Bill's explicit exception; this task tracks the external preservation separately. Own account Memory Core ChatGPT; board MemoryCoreChatGPT2 signed MemoryCoreChatGPT. Exact ledger is populated as actual uploads are created; do not assume planned filenames are actual image versions.

Related: https://github.com/swccg-guild/work/issues/381. Evidence: https://github.com/swccg-guild/work/tree/main/evidence/381. No approval question is outstanding. No detached worker is arranged.
